# Check-iN

> Check-iN is an Indian senior safety and medication app: daily check-ins, medication reminders, one-tap SOS, guardian alerts, and a secure medical vault.

Check-iN is built for Indian families caring for elderly parents. Seniors confirm they are well with scheduled check-ins, get reminders for every dose, and can raise an SOS with one tap. Nominated guardians receive alerts by app, WhatsApp, and email.
